text: Observed in the shared-expense-tracker pilot (e5dbe1f build): after the plan-review-retry envelope dispatched attempt 2 of the PlanReview job (job list showed running, attempts 2), `job watch <job-id>` returned immediately with the attempt-1 failure record and decision reasonCode JOB_RESULT_ALREADY_ACCEPTED. The agent had to poll `job list` instead. job watch should follow the newest attempt until it reaches a terminal state.
